(At Present Lodged In Sub Jail, Balotra)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Birbal Ram Bishnoi For Respondent(s) : Mr. Saleem Khan, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 16/05/2024

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.112/2023 registered at Police Station Kalyanpur Barmer, District Balotra, for offences under Sections 363, 366A, 376(1), 376D, 384 of IPC and Sections 3/4, 5(g)/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that the victim Mst.'M' who is aged about 17 years voluntarily eloped with the co-accused Dharma Ram aged about 22 years and travelled with him to various places using public transportation, however despite having ample opportunities, she did not inform the factum of she being abducted or subjected to forcible sexual assault-rape by the present petitioner or co-accused persons to anyone.

Learned counsel submitted that it is highly improbable that such a victim, [2024:RJ-JD:22100] (2 of 4)
[CRLMB-5538/2024] despite having ample opportunities would not disclose the factum of sexual assault-rape having been committed upon her, to anyone.

Learned counsel submitted that co-accused persons namely Jagdish (S.B. Cr. Misc. Bail Application No.3542/2024) and Bhaga Ram (S.B. Cr. Misc. Bail Application No.3543/2024) have already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide orders dated 21.03.2024 & 05.04.2024 respectively.

Further, attention of the Court was also drawn towards the medical examination report of the victim Mst. 'M', dated 13.12.2023, prepared by the Sr. Medical Officer, Community health Centre,
Kalyanpur wherein, no evidence of internal or external injury was found on the body of the victim Mst.'M'.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that there are as lot of variations and contradictions in the statements of the victim Mst.'M' recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. dated 12.12.2023 &
14.12.2023 and her statements recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C..

sentences.text:
Learned counsel submitted that though it is true that victim Mst.'M' initially in her statements recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
has stated that she was subjected to forcible sexual assault-rape by the present petitioner, however,
in her statements recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that she was subject for forcible sexual assault-rape by co-accused persons also who have been enlarged on bail by this Court.
[2024:RJ-JD:22100] (3 of 4) [CRLMB-5538/2024] Lastly, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the investigation against the petitioner has already been completed.

The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial against him will take sufficiently long time, therefore, no purpose would be served by keeping the petitioner behind the bars for indefinite period and thus, the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail.

Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that looking to the seriousness of allegations levelled against the present petitioner, the petitioner does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.
However, he was not in a position to refute the fact that above named co- accused have already been enlarged on bail by this Court.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case and after perusing the Challan papers, this Court prima facie finds that the victim Mst.'M' had travelled with co-accused Dharma Ram to various places using public transportation, however despite having ample opportunities, she did not inform the factum of she being abducted or subjected to forcible sexual assault-rape by the present petitioner or co- accused persons to anyone.

This Court also prima facie finds that there are lot of variations and contradictions in the contents of the FIR lodged by the complainant via-a-vis statements of the victim Mst.'M' recorded under various Sections of Cr.P.C.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

[2024:RJ-JD:22100] (4 of 4) [CRLMB-5538/2024] Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Rawal Singh S/o Hadman Singh shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.112/2023 registered at Police Station Kalyanpur Barmer, District Balotra, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.
